name: OtpInput
description: A one-time-code field rendered as separate slots: characters spring into place as you type, the active slot glows with a blinking caret, pasting fills every slot at once, and a completed code flashes green.
a11yNotes: Backed by a single native <input> (autocomplete="one-time-code", numeric inputMode) labelled by a visible <label> and described by a screen-reader hint with the expected length, so autofill, paste and screen readers see one field instead of N. The visual slots are aria-hidden. Typing auto-advances, Backspace steps back, Left/Right/Home/End move between slots and typing over a filled slot replaces it. invalid sets aria-invalid. Under prefers-reduced-motion characters fade without springing, and the caret blink, completion glow and error shake are disabled.

propsApi.name: length
propsApi.description: Number of characters in the code (1 to 12).

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the sanitized value on every change.

propsApi.name: onComplete
propsApi.description: Called when every slot is filled.

propsApi.name: mode
propsApi.description: Accepted characters; alphanumeric input is upper-cased.

propsApi.name: groupSize
propsApi.description: Insert a dash separator after every N slots; 0 disables grouping.

propsApi.name: mask
propsApi.description: Render dots instead of the typed characters.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the active slot ring and caret.

propsApi.name: invalid
propsApi.description: Red error state with a short shake; sets aria-invalid.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
